messages:
From: Marie Dupont <marie.dupont@greenwave.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-05-07T09:12:00+02:00
Subject: Tax documentation request: VAT validation for Redwood invoice INV-2026-3433

Hi Marissa,

I'm Marie from GreenWave Analytics (AP). We're processing your recent invoice INV-2026-3433 for services in April 2026 (EUR 48,750). Before we release payment, our internal tax team needs confirmation on whether the invoice should be treated under reverse-charge (B2B EU services) or standard VAT.

What we need from Redwood:
- Confirm Redwood's billing entity for this invoice (legal name + VAT number).
- A scanned VAT registration certificate or equivalent proof of EU VAT registration for the billing entity.
- Confirmation of place-of-supply: that the services are supplied to GreenWave in France and should be reverse-charged.
- Reissued invoice with reverse-charge wording if applicable (we require the VAT ID included).

If we don't receive evidence by 16 May, payment may be delayed. Can you confirm next steps and estimated timing?

Thanks,

Marie Dupont
Accounts Payable Lead
GreenWave Analytics

Hi Marie — thanks for the clear checklist. We're on it. Quick answers up-front:

- Billing entity: Redwood Inference, Inc. (EU branch: Redwood Inference EMEA B.V.) — EU VAT ID: NL812345678B01.
- I'll attach our VAT registration extract and run a VIES check to confirm live status.
- We believe reverse-charge applies for this engagement (B2B services where place of supply is the customer's establishment).

Plan:
1) I'll attach a scanned extract of our EU VAT registration (see attached: redwood-vat-registration-extract.pdf).
2) Legal will provide standard reverse-charge invoice wording and we'll reissue INV-2026-3433 with the VAT ID and required note.
3) Finance will perform VIES check and send a screenshot/export.

Target: reissue the invoice by end of next business day (2026-05-08). If you need an earlier confirmation for payment release, let me know and I can ask finance to provide the VIES output ASAP.

Best,

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Tax documentation request: VAT validation for Redwood invoice INV-2026-3433

Marie / team — legal here. We've reviewed the materials. Notes and next steps: 

1) VIES status: we will attach the VIES lookup export to the thread (please see later). If VIES returns the NL VAT ID as valid, reverse-charge is normally acceptable.
2) Invoice wording: include the customer's VAT ID, our billing entity VAT ID (NL812345678B01), and the phrase: "Reverse charge applies under Article 44 and 196 of the VAT Directive — VAT to be accounted for by the recipient." I attached a short text file with the recommended clause.
3) Self-billing / documentation: if GreenWave requires a formal self-billing agreement or a scanned VAT certificate, we can provide both. Send your template if needed.
4) Contract entity alignment: Ben — please confirm which legal entity on the PO/contract should be used to reissue the invoice. If it's the US parent, we may need to reassign charging to the EMEA branch and issue a credit + new invoice.

Attachments: reverse-charge-language.txt (plain text)

Lauren Bishop
Senior Counsel, Commercial
Redwood Inference

Hi Marie — final update and attached items.

- VIES check result: NL812345678B01 returned as Valid on 2026-05-12 (screenshot/export attached: vies-search-20260512.txt).
- We confirmed the contract's billing entity is Redwood Inference EMEA B.V. and have reissued the invoice accordingly. Attached: INV-2026-3433-redwood-rc-invoice.pdf. The invoice includes: both VAT IDs, the reverse-charge clause suggested by legal, and the net-only line item with VAT 0% and a note that recipient must account for VAT.
- Payment path: the reissued invoice keeps original payment terms (30 days). If you prefer we can send a Stripe invoice link to accelerate payment — let me know.

Please confirm receipt and whether the documentation is sufficient for release of funds. If GreenWave's tax team still needs a formal self-billing agreement, share the template and we'll route to legal for signature.

Thanks all — closing loop on this ticket pending GreenWave confirmation.

Best,
